say.speaker: machop
say.text: Told you my shortcut would get us through fast! Look ahead, you can already spot the Emerald Capital spires!

say.speaker: partner
say.text: Whoa, and check out this chunk of mineral-rich Iron wedged by the cavern arch! Plus there is a quiet prairie trail branching off to the west.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Great guiding, Machop! Let's check our gear on the road before we make our final push to the capital.
